company_type: Indian 2W/3W manufacturer expanding into electric and hydrogen mobility

technology.technology_name: Chetak Electric Scooter Platform + CNG Bike + Hydrogen Scooter R&D (via Chetak Technology Ltd subsidiary)
technology.description: Bajaj Auto operates Chetak Technology Ltd (CTL) — a wholly-owned subsidiary — for its electric vehicle and alternative-fuel mobility programmes. The Akurdi (Pune) EV plant commissioned June 2022 has 500,000 e-2W/year capacity. The Chetak EV holds significant share of Indian e-2W market. CTL is also developing a hydrogen-powered scooter; patents around the hydrogen fuel system have been filed and Bajaj could be the first Indian manufacturer of a hydrogen 2W.
technology.problem_solved: Affordable mass-market electric mobility for urban Indian commuters; alternative-fuel pathway for cost-conscious users (CNG bike); long-term hydrogen pathway for 2W.
technology.innovation_summary: Layered fuel tank design and BMS patents on Chetak EV platform; hydrogen fuel system patent filed; CNG bike (110cc) planned for 2024 launch.
technology.unique_selling_points: Manufacturing scale + brand; CTL focused on alternative fuels; ₹750 Cr Akurdi plant investment
technology.application_area: Personal mobility (urban commuters), shared mobility fleets, last-mile delivery
technology.target_industries: Auto OEMs (peer licensing), fleet operators, last-mile logistics
technology.patent_status: Numerous granted (Chetak EV platform); H2 fuel system patent filed
technology.patent_jurisdiction: IN primary; selected PCT for H2
technology.ip_owner: Bajaj Auto Ltd / Chetak Technology Ltd
technology.preferred_license_type: Bajaj typically buys IP outright; would be a licensee from NRDC, not licensor
technology.certification_status: ARAI certification; BIS; AIS-156 for batteries; FAME-II eligible
